text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The JBC Classic generated immense 
excitement, and Smart Falcon's popularity 
certainly played a part in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at long last, the year-end 
pinnacle of dirt racing, the Tokyo 
Daishoten, is the target race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, at the end of the year, the 
public's eyes were naturally fixed on the 
Arima Kinen. After being reminded of this 
in a chat with a fan, Smart Falcon—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gather intel for her next goal, the 
Tokyo Daishoten, she decided to go watch 
the Arima Kinen.
